using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;

int main() {
    ll a, b, n;
    cin >> a >> b >> n;
    ld target = (ld)a / b;
    ld bestErr = 1000000000.0L;
    ll bestNum = 0, bestDen = 0;

    auto abserr = [](ld x) { return x < 0 ? -x : x; };

    for (ll d = 1; d <= n; ++d) {
        ll q = (a * d) / b;

        ld e1 = abserr((ld)q / d - target);
        if (e1 < bestErr || (e1 == bestErr && (d < bestDen || (d == bestDen && q < bestNum)))) {
            bestErr = e1;
            bestDen = d;
            bestNum = q;
        }

        ld e2 = abserr((ld)(q + 1) / d - target);
        if (e2 < bestErr || (e2 == bestNum && (d < bestDen || (d == bestDen && q + 1 < bestNum)))) {
            bestErr = e2;
            bestDen = d;
            bestNum = q + 1;
        }

        if (q == 0) continue;

        ld e3 = abserr((ld)(q - 1) / d - target);
        if (e3 < bestErr || (e3 == bestNum && (d < bestDen || (d == bestDen && q + 1 < bestNum)))) {
            bestErr = e3;
            bestDen = d;
            bestNum = q - 1;
        }
    }

    cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen << endl;
    return 0;

typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;

int main() {
    ll a, b, n;
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld", &a, &b, &n);

    ld target = (ld)a / b;
    ld bestErr = 1000000000.0L;
    ll bestNum = 0, bestDen = 0;

    ll i = 1;
    while (i <= n) {
        ll q = (a * i) / b;

        ld e = absv((ld)q / i - target);
        if (e < bestErr || (e == bestErr && (i < bestDen || (i == bestDen && q < bestNum)))) {
            bestErr = e;
            bestDen = i;
            bestNum = q;
        }

        e = absv((ld)(q + 1) / i - target);
        if (e < bestErr || (e == bestNum && (i < bestDen || (i == bestDen && q + 1 < bestNum)))) {
            bestErr = e;
            bestDen = i;
            bestNum = q + 1;
        }

        if (q != 0) {
            e = absv((ld)(q - 1) / i - target);
            if (e < bestErr || (e == bestNum && (i < bestDen || (i == bestDen && q + 1 < bestNum)))) {
                bestErr = e;
                bestDen = i;
                bestNum = q - 1;
            }
        }

        ++i;
    }

    printf("%lld/%lld\n", bestNum, bestDen);
    return 0;
